_comment: Cards that exist only for tests/unit/mana/test_convoke_colors.py. Never part of a deck list. t_scheme is Lethal Scheme's shape: a {2}{B}{B} convoke instant that destroys a creature or planeswalker and has each creature that convoked it connive. t_black_bear and t_orzhov_bear are a mono-black and a white-black 2/2, so a pip can be paid by colour; t_bear (testing.cards.json) is the green one that cannot pay {B}.

Destroy target creature or planeswalker. Each creature that convoked this spell connives. (Draw a card, then discard a card. If you discarded a nonland card, put a +1/+1 counter on that creature.)
